device.woofers: 2 x 2.0 W RMS (2.5 W peak) bottom-firing micro-woofers (SPOL)
device.tweeters: 2 x 2.0 W RMS (2.5 W peak) top-firing tweeters (SPOR)

stage_ordering_contract.critical_rule: BassEngine taps raw full-range 32-175 Hz mono input BEFORE (in parallel with) the Klippel dynamic sliding HPF!
stage_ordering_contract.rationale: When high playback SPL + deep sub-bass glides the 4th-order Cytomic TPT-SVF protection HPF upward from 82 Hz toward 155-158 Hz to prevent micro-woofer over-excursion, tapping raw pre-HPF 32-175 Hz ensures the 3-band missing-fundamental harmonic synthesizer is NEVER starved of sub-bass fundamentals and seamlessly hands off physical bass into upper-harmonic residue pitch (105-420 Hz).
stage_ordering_contract.handoff_gain_law: g2_handoff = 1.0 + 0.30 * s_eff  (boosts Band 2 harmonic residue up to +2.28 dB as physical HPF slides toward f_max)

static_brickwall_hpf.topology: 180 Hz 8th-order Butterworth HPF (48 dB/oct) + downstream 110 Hz 4th-order HPF (24 dB/oct)

chebyshev_normalization_and_dc_bug.cause: Mean-rectified envelope env = (2/pi)*A yields peak u_raw = pi/2 = 1.5708 > 1.50 clamp on every pure sine, violating Chebyshev domain |u| <= 1.0 and injecting uncentered T2(u) = 2u^2 - 1 DC + T3 fundamental bleed

speech_gate_double_failure.false_open_on_male_speech: Band B (80-155 Hz) captures male/baritone fundamental F0 (98-118 Hz), holding legacy speech_gate open at 1.000 on dry male podcasts
speech_gate_double_failure.vocal_music_choke: 80 ms symmetric envelope chokes bass down to 0.641 (-3.86 dB) during vocal + sparse kick passages

windows_stradale_reference.reconciled_insight: Dell/Waves tuned physical bass extension down to 80-82 Hz (N360_BASS_CUT=80 Hz, MV2 dynamic excursion clamp at 82-93 Hz with 1 ms attack, 64 Hz physical bass unattenuated up to 75% system volume) paired with MaxxBass centered at 88.0-103.2 Hz and 3.5x volume-adaptive harmonic scaling below 45% volume.

hybrid_sliding_hpf.topology: 4th-order Butterworth Cytomic TPT-SVF (2 cascaded Zero-Delay Feedback SVF sections per channel)

klippel_subband_estimator.octave_glide_law: fc = f_min * (f_max / f_min) ** (excursion_guard * smoothstep((exc_env - exc_onset) / (exc_ceil - exc_onset)))

three_band_missing_fundamental_synthesiz.interband_crossover_slope: 8th-order Butterworth (48 dB/oct) at 68 Hz and 115 Hz for cross-band IMD isolation and male F0 rejection; 4th-order Butterworth (24 dB/oct) at outer 32 Hz and 175 Hz edges

bands.name: deep_sub
bands.psychoacoustic_role: Synthesizes 2f, 3f, 4f harmonic series (e.g. 50 Hz -> 100, 150, 200 Hz) with f0 spacing locked to true sub-bass fundamental pitch

bands.name: kick_punch_bass
bands.psychoacoustic_role: Dominant warm 2nd harmonic + 3rd harmonic pitch lock (matches Waves StradaleMLK 88-103.2 Hz MaxxBass band)

bands.name: upper_bass_warmth_bridge
bands.phase_alignment_note: Negative T2 weight (-1.0) compensates the 2*phi(135 Hz) ~= 190 deg second-harmonic phase rotation induced by Band 2's 68 Hz BW8 HPF, turning -10.1 dB crossover cancellation into +14.52 dB constructive summation at 270 Hz
bands.psychoacoustic_role: Pure even-order chest warmth bridge into the XPS 17's 220-360 Hz acoustic radiation sweet spot with 192.9 dB isolated odd-harmonic rejection

three_band_missing_fundamental_synthesiz.dc_suppression: Adaptive analytical mean subtraction E[u^2], E[u^4] + 1st-order 22 Hz DC blocker + per-band output HPFs (105-200 Hz)

vocal_safe_music_detector.architecture: BW8-isolated sub-presence (32-68 Hz, strictly below human male/baritone glottal F0 >= 85 Hz) + matched 1.8 s musical hold envelope + 300-3400 Hz syllabic modulation index

iso226_2023_equal_loudness.standard: ISO 226:2023 (3rd Edition, Normal equal-loudness-level contours, 29 1/3-octave bands)
